name: 文件中心
description: 文件中心 — 自包含的 office 引擎（创建/编辑/预览 docx/pptx/xlsx/pdf），基于内置的 GenOffice 引擎（Apache-2.0），无需外部工具或联网安装

tools.name: office_guide
tools.description: The op vocabulary for this plugin's engine. pptx has a grouped op list — call with no group for the grouped names and a one-line signature for each, or with a group for that group's field tables, examples and common mistakes. docx returns its op shape and op list. xlsx has no op registry: its ops are plain cell edits, and this tool returns their shape. Read this BEFORE writing ops — guessing field names is the usual cause of a rejected batch.

domain.description: Which document family. pptx, docx and xlsx are wired; pdf is not, and answers with a plain "not wired yet".

group.description: Return one op group's full guide instead of the vocabulary. An unknown group lists the valid ones.

style.description: vocabulary (default) = grouped names, cheapest. signatures = one signature line per op.

tools.name: office_read
tools.description: Read a document's structure: pptx slides and their elements, xlsx sheets and their cells, or a docx document's blocks. Ids, cell addresses and block indexes are what office_edit takes — read first, then edit. For docx the document must already be open in the file viewer.

path.description: Absolute path to the document. For docx it must be the document currently open in the viewer.

tools.name: office_edit
tools.description: Apply a batch of ops to a document and save it. The batch is atomic: if any op is rejected, nothing is written and the failures say what to fix. Use dryRun to validate a batch without touching the file. Get the shape of each op from office_guide — pptx ops are named operations, xlsx ops are cell edits, docx ops are {op, target, fields} records. For docx the document must already be open in the file viewer: its ops drive the live editor, so there is no headless path.

path.description: Absolute path to the document. For docx it must be the document currently open in the viewer.

ops.description: The ops to apply, in order. Get the shape of each op from office_guide.

dryRun.description: Validate and report the plan without writing anything.

tools.name: files_probe_write
tools.description: P9a 验收:write a file via the filesystem.write capability (with optional mtime conflict detection).

expectedMtime.description: Optional mtime read earlier — write refuses on conflict

tools.name: files_probe_read
tools.description: P9a 验收:read a file via the filesystem.read capability, returning content + mtime.

tools.name: files_probe_open
tools.description: P9a 验收:programmatically open a panel via panel.open. Defaults to the viewer; pass panelId to open another contributed panel.

path.description: File to show in the viewer (viewer panel only)
